It may run only while ALL e-stops E1, E2 are healthy (TRUE) AND all guards G1 are closed (TRUE); any unhealthy e-stop or open guard immediately de-energises it and blocks starting. Write an IEC 61131-3 ST PROGRAM named p_chain_2e1g_hoist with output Hoist.
